summary: Meta announces the beta release of Muse Code, described as its first coding agent that coordinates multiple persistent subagents, alongside a newer model version, Muse Spark 1.2.

mechanisms.reason: The post describes a coding agent that coordinates multiple persistent subagents to complete engineering tasks with less human intervention, indicating a shift toward agent-executed work.
